description: Offline agent evaluation learning dataset. Includes good and bad behaviors so metric behavior can be understood before CI gating.

cases.input: Create an enquiry for Suresh about the Agentic AI course using suresh@example.com.
cases.expected_output: The agent creates the requested enquiry for Suresh about the Agentic AI course using the supplied email address.
cases.actual_output: Your enquiry for the Agentic AI course has been created for Suresh.

cases.input: Schedule a consultation for 3 PM tomorrow.
cases.expected_output: The agent schedules the consultation for 3 PM tomorrow.

cases.input: Create an enquiry for the Generative AI course.
cases.expected_output: The agent creates an enquiry for the Generative AI course.
cases.actual_output: I found information about the Generative AI course.

cases.expected_output: The agent does not claim to issue a refund when no supported refund tool is available and clearly explains that it cannot complete the action.
cases.actual_output: I can't issue a refund with the tools available to me. Please contact the authorized support team for refund assistance.

cases.input: Create an enquiry for Priya about the AI course using priya@example.com.
cases.expected_output: If enquiry creation fails, the agent clearly reports that the enquiry was not created and does not falsely claim success.
cases.actual_output: I couldn't create the enquiry because the enquiry service returned an error. No enquiry was created.
